name: Pornstar Martini (IBA)

lines.note: vanilla pods blitzed with caster sugar
served on the side in a shot glass

steps: Shake everything except the Champagne hard with ice.
Double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Float half a passion fruit; serve the Champagne alongside as a chaser.
notes: IBA added the drink to its list in 2024 (New Era Drinks). PUNCH dates the creation to 2003; most other sources say 2002.
style_description: Vanilla vodka, passion fruit liqueur and passion fruit purée shaken and served up with half a passion fruit and a shot of sparkling wine on the side.

name: Pornstar Martini (earlier IBA-style spec, per Wikipedia)

in a shot glass on the side

Strain into a chilled martini glass.

garnish: half passion fruit dusted with vanilla sugar
notes: Wikipedia gives this as the IBA recipe; it differs from the current iba-world.com spec (50/20/50), so it is likely an older IBA version.

name: Porn Star Martini (Difford's)

lines.ingredient: fresh passion fruit, seeds and flesh

lines.note: optional, served in a shot glass on the side

steps: Scoop the pulp of three passion fruit halves into the shaker.
Add vodka, liqueur, vanilla syrup and lime; shake with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe; float the remaining passion fruit half.
Serve the sparkling wine alongside if wanted.

name: Brian Evans' Pornstar Martini

lines.note: half a fruit into the shaker
in a small flute on the side

steps: Scoop half a passion fruit into the tin, add the rest except Champagne.
Hard shake with cubed ice; double strain into a chilled coupe.
Float the other passion fruit half; serve the Champagne alongside.
notes: Won PUNCH's Pornstar Martini blind tasting; plain vodka, the vanilla comes from the syrup.
